steps.name: 1-boot
steps.eval: JSON.stringify({nestUI: typeof NestUI, rows: document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr').length, tableText: document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,200)})

steps.name: 3-create-state
steps.eval: (function(){ var m=document.getElementById('create-modal'); var ids=[]; m.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea').forEach(function(e){ if(e.id) ids.push(e.id); }); return JSON.stringify({visible: !m.classList.contains('hidden'), fields: ids, text: m.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,160)}); })()

steps.name: 6-edit-state
steps.eval: (function(){ var m=document.getElementById('edit-modal'); var vals={}; m.querySelectorAll('input,select').forEach(function(e){ if(e.id) vals[e.id]=e.value; }); return JSON.stringify({visible: !m.classList.contains('hidden'), values: vals}); })()

steps.name: 8-status-toggle-presence
steps.eval: (function(){ var t=document.querySelector('[onclick*="toggleUserStatus"]'); return JSON.stringify({hasToggle: !!t, label: t ? t.textContent.trim().slice(0,30) : null, search: !!document.querySelector('#searchInput,#search,input[type="search"]')}); })()
